prompt:
Research the officially documented limits of the Telegram Bot API: messages per second, file upload and download size. Cite Telegram's own documentation or FAQ and quote the limits.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
I'll research the officially documented limits of the Telegram Bot API based on the web search results provided.

Here are my findings:

**Message Rate Limits:**

SOURCE: https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq/ | QUOTE: "In a single chat, avoid sending more than one message per second." | CLAIM: Bots are limited to sending no more than one message per second in a single chat

SOURCE: https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq/ | QUOTE: "In a group, bots are not be able to send more than 20 messages per minute." | CLAIM: Bots are limited to 20 messages per minute in groups

SOURCE: https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq/ | QUOTE: "For bulk notifications, bots are not able to broadcast more than about 30 messages per second, unless they enable paid broadcasts to increase the limit." | CLAIM: Bots are limited to approximately 30 messages per second for bulk notifications by default

SOURCE: https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq/ | QUOTE: "Enabling paid broadcasts in @BotFather allows a bot to broadcast up to 1000 messages per second." | CLAIM: Bots with paid broadcasts enabled can broadcast up to 1000 messages per second

**File Size Limits:**

SOURCE: https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq/ | QUOTE: "Use the getFile method. Please note that this will only work with files of up to 20 MB in size." | CLAIM: The standard file download limit via getFile method is 20 MB

SOURCE: https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq/ | QUOTE: "Bots can currently send files of any type of up to 50 MB in size" | CLAIM: The standard file upload limit for bots is 50 MB

SOURCE: https://core.telegram.org/bots/features | QUOTE: "Official | 20MB | 50MB | HTTPS | 443,80,88,8443 | 1-100" | CLAIM: Official Bot API servers have 20MB max file download and 50MB max file upload limits

**Local Bot API Server (Increased Limits):**

SOURCE: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api/ | QUOTE: "Download files without a size limit." | CLAIM: Running a local Bot API server removes the file download size limit

SOURCE: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api/ | QUOTE: "Upload files up to 2000 MB." | CLAIM: Running a local Bot API server increases file upload limit to 2000 MB

SOURCE: https://core.telegram.org/bots/features | QUOTE: "Local | Unlimited | 2000MB | HTTP | Any port | 1-100000" | CLAIM: Local Bot API servers have unlimited file download and 2000MB max file upload limits
